incidents-bot: Paging: ILB cross-region routing suppression detected for Private VPCs in eu-west1->us-central1. Error class: CONTROL_PLANE_429.

maria (oncall): ack. seeing 5xx spike on private-vpc customers. digging into logs now, will post findings.

kevin (sre): I can help. initial query: which customers? can you paste sample request ids.

maria (oncall): sample req ids: req-abc123, req-def456. Errors are like `route-propagation-failed` and 502 from proxy.

elaine (eng-net): @maria can you run `gcloud compute forwarding-rules list --filter=\"region:(eu-west1)\" --project=redwood-prod` and paste a row? suspect ILB control plane API returning 429s.

maria (oncall): pasted output from run: ```
> gcloud compute forwarding-rules describe ilb-redwood-eu --region=eu-west1
error: 429 Too Many Requests: control plane request quota exceeded
``` 

samir (eng-runtime): that's consistent with GCP control plane throttling. any recent churn from monitoring or CI jobs?

maria (oncall): looking at egress logs, I see a sharp spike in calls to `networking.googleapis.com` from a small set of external IPs owned by `SignalPulse` (observability vendor). They started high-frequency polling at 04:12 UTC.

kevin (sre): oh — external observability agent token refresh loop maybe. we've seen SignalPulse agents misbehave before. can we correlate source IPs to customer integrations?

maria (oncall): correlating... yes, three Private VPC customers use SignalPulse agent (customer-a, customer-b, partner-x). Their agents are re-issuing API calls repeatedly due to a 401->token refresh loop.

jessica (support): flagging Customer Success to prepare possible notifications: customers impacted: customer-a (critical), partner-x (moderate). Is there a temporary mitigation we can push?

elaine (eng-net): mitigation plan:
- throttle/blackhole traffic from SignalPulse agent IPs at edge for our control plane calls (temporary)
- request GCP to lift throttles (support ticket), escalate to P0
- apply manual route repair for affected ILBs once control plane available

kevin (sre): immediate quick mitigation: block egress from monitoring agents in our control plane subnet via firewall rule so they stop hammering. Maria, can you apply a deny rule for those source IPs?

maria (oncall): applying deny rule now: ```
> gcloud compute firewall-rules create deny-signalpulse-controlplane --direction=INGRESS --priority=1000 --action=DENY --rules=tcp:443 --source-ranges=203.0.113.12/32,203.0.113.34/32 --target-tags=controlplane-proxy
``` 

maria (oncall): applied. Observability traffic to control plane dropped. Watching for control plane recovery.

incidents-bot: Note: automatic page handoff in 20m. current severity: Sev 2 -> potential escalations if control plane not recovered.

gcp-support-bot: Support ticket created: 1234567890. GCP response ETA 15-30m. Noted control plane 429 errors linked to external agent storm.

samir (eng-runtime): can we also enable fallback routing of cross-region traffic to local model pool to avoid hitting ILB? config: toggle `cross_region_preference: local-first` for affected customers.

elaine (eng-net): manual route repair started: steps in runbook `/runbooks/gcp-ilb-route-repair` executed. Running: `gcloud compute forwarding-rules update-ilb --region=eu-west1 --repair` (pseudo command)

maria (oncall): control plane error rate trending down after firewall. GCP support confirms throttles are easing. I've started re-propagating routes for customer-a. Observed successful healthcheck re-registration for one backend.

kevin (sre): good. mark mitigation: ingress firewall deny of SignalPulse IPs = short-term fix. followups: (1) CS notify customers whose agents caused the storm, ask them to update agent; (2) Reach out to SignalPulse to get root cause and patch; (3) Long-term: rate-limit control plane calls per-customer and detect token refresh loops.

jessica (support): I'll draft emails and post to `#customer-notify` once we have confirmed list and estimated ETA to full recovery.

ops-handoff-bot: Handoff scheduled to night-shift SRE: kevin (oncall) at 23:00 UTC. Current state: partial recovery, some customers still seeing higher latencies (10-20% error). Attachments: support ticket 1234567890 link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1234567890

maria (oncall): final status update before handoff: control plane stable, route propagation succeeded for 8/10 affected ILBs, two remain in repair and expected to be back in 30-45m. Root cause: third-party observability agent token refresh loop hitting GCP networking control plane causing 429s and temporary ILB route suppression. Actions taken: firewall deny, GCP ticket, manual route repair, CS notifications queued.

kevin (sre): during handoff: monitor healthchecks, ensure no regressions, validate backend counts and observe error rates for 30m. Escalate to eng-net if re-throttle.

elaine (eng-net): follow-up items: 1) implement per-customer control plane rate limiting, 2) add detection for third-party token storms in our telemetry, 3) write postmortem with timeline and customer impact. Assigning to eng-networking + eng-sre.

jessica (support): customer communications ready. I'll send "incident impact" templates to Customer Success for customer-a and partner-x after final confirmation.

incidents-bot: Incident update: transitioning to monitoring. Severity: reduced to S3. If errors rise, reopen and notify on-call.

maria (oncall): thanks team. handing off to kevin now. I'm available if anything flares.

kevin (sre): taking it. ack.
